title: BulletLab Arsenal Robot Package Metadata
description: Schema for metadata.json files in BulletLab Arsenal robot packages. A single package may contain multiple robot models (e.g. different DOF variants of the same family) sharing one set of meshes.

name.description: Unique package identifier. Must match the directory name exactly. Lowercase alphanumeric and underscores only.

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the robot family (e.g. 'Unitree G1', 'Clearpath Husky').

description.description: Short paragraph describing the robot family, its kinematic structure, and intended use cases.

version.description: Semantic version of this Arsenal package (e.g. '1.0.0'). Increment on any change to URDF, meshes, or metadata.

arsenal_version.description: Version of the Arsenal package specification this metadata conforms to. Used for schema migration. Currently must be '1'.

source.description: URL of the upstream source repository or original CAD file release.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for the robot assets (e.g. 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0', 'BSD-2-Clause'). Must match the LICENSE file in the package. Complex or non-SPDX licenses should be noted here and explained fully in NOTICE.md.

authors.description: Original authors or creators of the robot description. Preserve upstream attributions accurately.

maintainers.description: People responsible for maintaining this Arsenal package. Typically the contributor(s) who ported the robot.

tags.description: Discovery tags for the package. Use lowercase, hyphenated terms (e.g. 'wheeled', 'legged', 'differential-drive', 'humanoid', 'arm', 'mobile').

minimum_bulletlab_version.description: BulletLab version requirement string (e.g. '>=0.2.0'). Must be tested against the specified version.

models.description: List of all robot models contained in this package. A package must define at least one model. Exactly one model must have 'default': true.

items.description: A single installable robot model within the package.

id.description: Unique identifier for this model within the package (e.g. '29dof', 'standard', 'lite'). Lowercase alphanumeric and underscores only.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for this specific model variant (e.g. '29 DOF', 'Standard', 'Lite').

entrypoint.description: Path to the URDF file for this model, relative to the package root. Must begin with 'urdf/' (e.g. 'urdf/robot_29dof.urdf').

default.description: If true, this model is loaded when no specific model ID is requested. Exactly one model per package must set this to true.

description.description: Optional short description specific to this model variant.
